verdict.rationale: Stating identity, account and credential requirements up front is a fair question for a company-register filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence only says that publication or deposit orders are submitted via the Publikations-Plattform, and that the Bilanz-Navigator explains how and where to disclose accounting documents. Neither item documents the account, credential or identity-proofing steps a founder must complete before filing, so neither earns credit.
